content: चर्चरिका, -चर्चरी [चर्च्-बा˚ अरन् गौराङीष्] .²1 A kind of song. .²2 Striking the hands to beat time (in music). .²3 The recitation of scholars. .²4 Festive sport, festive cries or merriment. .²5 A festival .²6 Flattery. .²7 Curled hair. .²8 Triple symphony. .²9 Alternate recitation of a poem by two persons.
